title: Weak SSH daemon setting (listen) — review required
description: sshd weakens authentication or session controls: ListeningAddress 0.0.0.0 (listen). Empty passwords, disabled PAM, forwarding, and lax limits widen remote access. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer hardens via scoped listen addresses.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of Match blocks.
